verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS. Its AI Teammates are workflow agents, not AI coding agents, so restoring a coding agent's session to a version-history checkpoint is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana runs coding-agent sessions or offers session checkpoints that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
